target_name: Van Mossel Voorraad (inventory/stock-count app, Van Mossel Automotive Group)
authorization: Written permission from CEO Rens Boeren (cooby). Scope: everything. Recon/non-destructive phase only.
scope_note: Primary target voorraad.cooby.nl on shared Hostinger VPS 187.77.163.64 (srv1429097.hstgr.cloud, AS47583, Paris FR). No CDN/WAF, direct origin. Parent cooby.nl on TransIP NL (37.97.254.27). Siblings on same IP (appbase, cc, dj, fleet, laadpaal, ovm, salon, telefonie) are distinct apps by the hosting vendor cooby for other clients - NOT Van Mossel code/data, so treated as out of primary scope per scope clarification; noted only as shared-host pivot context. appbase.cooby.nl flagged as a possible shared backend worth a separate look if authorization is confirmed to cover all cooby.nl.
ruled_out: CORS misconfig on /api/* - no ACAO reflected for cross-origin Origin (locked down)
Route enumeration via /api - blanket 401 on every /api/* path incl nonexistent, no oracle
Security-header gaps - strong CSP, HSTS, XFO DENY, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy all present; CSRF cookie is __Host- HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax
Self-service signup - none exists (activation-link only), so cannot self-register test accounts
Account enumeration via login error wording - generic 'E-mailadres of wachtwoord is niet correct' for both unknown email and wrong password
Login CSRF - double-submit __Host- token PLUS Origin/Referer check; POST without matching Origin returns 403 before credential eval

open_threads.title: Activation-link / account-provisioning token flow
open_threads.why: Only way to get an account is a 'persoonlijke activatielink' from Internal Audit. Token route/format unknown (dummy tokens bounce to /login). If token is predictable, guessable, non-expiring, or activation allows setting arbitrary identity/role, this is an unauth account-takeover / foothold. Needs a real activation link from operator to analyze.

open_threads.title: Multi-tenant / branch IDOR on /api/*
open_threads.why: Inventory app for Van Mossel (many dealers/branches). /api probes imply objects by location/dealer/branch/item/count. Blanket auth hides routes unauth; need an authenticated session to walk object-by-ID endpoints and test cross-branch/cross-user scoping. Highest-impact candidate per high-value patterns.

open_threads.title: Login POST behavior (enum / rate-limit / lockout)
open_threads.why: POST /login tested with operator approval (wrong creds only, nonexistent email). Result: generic error (no enumeration). NO rate-limiting / NO lockout / NO throttle across 13 rapid failed attempts, stable ~0.36s, no 429 / Retry-After / ratelimit headers. CSRF token reusable within the 1h session (not single-use). CONFIRMED finding F1 (missing brute-force protection); threshold not pushed higher on live system.

open_threads.title: Client-side scanning PWA (post-auth)
open_threads.why: CSP allows wasm-unsafe-eval + cdn.jsdelivr.net + tessdata.projectnaptha.com (Tesseract.js OCR) + camera. Authenticated SPA/PWA bundle (JS, source maps, API base URLs, feature flags) only visible after login - review once account provisioned.

open_threads.title: Shared-host pivot context
open_threads.why: 8 sibling apps on same VPS with different stacks (Next.js, gunicorn/Django, nginx). appbase.cooby.nl may be a shared backend. Out of primary scope (other clients) but relevant if a host-level issue surfaces.

findings.title: No brute-force protection on login (missing rate-limit / lockout)
findings.detail: POST /login applies no rate-limiting, account lockout, or throttling. 13 rapid failed attempts all returned 401 with stable ~0.36s timing, no 429 / Retry-After / ratelimit headers. With no self-service password reset (admin-provisioned passwords), this enables credential stuffing and online password guessing against any known email. Threshold above 13 not tested on live system.

findings.title: cooby.nl email auth gaps (no DMARC, SPF ~all)
findings.detail: Parent domain has SPF v=spf1 ~all and no DMARC/DKIM observed - spoofing-adjacent. Domain-level, not the app.
